name: How do I know if my existing home needs air sealing before a major renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my existing home needs air sealing before a major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your existing home may benefit from air sealing include noticeable drafts, varying temperatures between rooms, high energy bills, or excessive dust accumulation. During our initial consultation for a major renovation, we assess your home's current envelope performance to identify potential air leakage points. This assessment informs our integrated design-build plan, allowing us to proactively address these issues as part of your customized renovation, ensuring a more comfortable and energy-efficient outcome for your whole-home remodel or addition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, uneven temperatures, high energy bills, or dust. We assess your home's envelope during consultation to integrate air sealing into your renovation plan.
